_comment: Per-repo allow-list for issue-sorter's trust check (spec-ticketing-watch-triage.md REQ-005/REQ-008). Append-only -- an author is added here only via REQ-006 (already-trusted auto-route) or REQ-008b (a human's explicit approval of a held item); never removed (REQ-009's denial path never touches this file; revocation is out of scope per the SPEC's Non-goals).
bootstrap_note: First-ever ops-issues firing, no prior allow-list existed. Seeded with the repo owner/maintainer only: every one of the 16 issues and 20 PRs in the repo's full history (verified via `gh issue list --state all` / `gh pr list --state all`, 2026-07-18) was authored by kimgranlund, who is also the GitHub repo owner (`gh repo view` owner.login), the ADR-0002/ADR-0003 ratifying maintainer (both ADRs record 'ratified: maintainer, in-session AskUserQuestion'), and the local git user (Kim Granlund). No other author has ever filed against this repo, so no one else can be evidenced as friendly yet -- the next unfamiliar author is correctly held, not guessed onto this list.

policy.note: REQ-011 bootstrap interview (interactive AskUserQuestion, 2026-07-18): private repo, both approved collaborators offered as candidates. Owner confirmed the roster as kimgranlund only -- mgrabovskyi deliberately NOT pre-seeded; their first filing is held per REQ-007 and approval adds them per REQ-008. Standing rule for future collaborators: hold-first-filing (repo access alone never auto-lists an author). Allow-list membership affects only hold-vs-mint (REQ-012): no PR, issue, or ticket is ever auto-actioned for any author.
policy.github_mcp_offer_note: REQ-013 offer originally resolved 2026-07-25 as declined (commit 873f064), and documented there as terminal per spec-ticketing-watch-triage.md -- no later firing was meant to re-offer or re-ask. The owner explicitly overrode that in a later same-day interactive session: decision flipped to accepted. A project-scoped, read-only-scoped GitHub MCP server may now be offered/wired for this repo; gh CLI remains available alongside it, not replaced. This entry is the override record -- if REQ-013's terminal-decision contract is read literally, this override is itself the exception the spec didn't anticipate, and is recorded here rather than silently applied.

friendlies.reason: repo owner / maintainer -- bootstrap seed, evidenced by 36/36 historical issues+PRs and both ADR ratifications; roster confirmed by the owner in the 2026-07-18 REQ-011 bootstrap interview
